material.title: Packham’s Shipping Agency — customer quotation form
material.source_version: IELTS Sample Tasks 2023; isolated prompt excerpt

verification.method: Official PDF fetched HTTP 200; content and question/page ranges inspected; prompt excerpt reopened and rendered for QA
verification.audio_verification: HTTP 200 audio/mpeg; downloaded ID3+MP3 parsed by afinfo without playback

freshness.basis: PROFILE.md, PROGRESS.md and AUDIT.md read on 2026-10-12; confirm learner has not seen key at session start

material.delivery: Give local prompt-only file; do not give bundled source, key or sample responses before done. Resolve relative local file path against the project root.

result_collection.primary: At initial attempt, learner answers directly in chat numbered 1–8, or writes on paper and sends a photo/screenshot. Never ask to retype all answers after done.

difficulty.note: No official band or difficulty assigned to this extract.

suggested_session.coach_timing_estimate: 2 minutes read instruction, 1 minute scan form, about 2 minutes 35 seconds single play, 2 minutes finish/capture, 9 minutes feedback, remainder next action
suggested_session.score_policy: Report /8 only; no IELTS band. Count audio play from learner report; coach never starts it.

coach_reference.content: exact key and transcript/passage excerpts; never attach in learner instructions

answer :

provenance.reference: Pesan Tata pada chat ini, 13 Oktober 2026; delapan jawaban Packham lengkap, teks mentah dipertahankan termasuk escape/entity.

result.verification_method: Jawaban awal chat dicocokkan dengan cache resmi versi PDF 2023; checksum/source/rentang lolos references.py 13 Oktober 2026; prompt PDF diperiksa visual. Skor coach, bukan examiner. Q5 dinilai sesuai teks yang tersedia, masih ambigu.

answers.proof: Transcript p4: surname spelled M-K-E-R-E; key p7 Mkere.
Transcript p5: college spelled W-E-S-T-A-L-L; key p7 Westall. Extra repeated numbering in raw message treated as formatting, not part of answer.
Transcript p5 and key p7: BS8 9PU. Spaces are not the error; submitted T differs from P.
Transcript p5: width 0.75m. Submitted 7,5 interpreted as decimal 7.5, with no unit; does not match key p7 0.75 m or 75 cm.
Transcript p5: height 0.5m. Raw ,5 remains ambiguous and lacks the metre/cm unit required by listed key variants; not awarded on present evidence. No inferred missing character.
Transcript p5: some books; key p7 permits books for Q6/7 in either order.
Transcript p5: some toys; key p7 permits toys for Q6/7 in either order.

Transcript p6: clothes/books 1500 pounds plus toys 200 pounds, total 1700 pounds. Numeric value matches key p7 1,700; pounds explicitly names the same currency and is within word limit. Prompt inspected visually: no conflicting unit beside blank. Accepted as same numeric value, not an examiner decision.

feedback.strength: Menangkap dua isi kotak (books, toys) dan total nilai £1,700 dengan benar.
patterns: Pada attempt ini, ejaan detail belum tepat: Mkere, Westall, BS8 9PU. Belum disimpulkan sebagai kelemahan menetap.
Ukuran perlu angka desimal dan satuan yang tepat: 0.75 m untuk width, 0.5 m untuk height. Nomor 5 ,5 ambigu dan tanpa satuan.
feedback.action: Review singkat: tulis kembali tiga ejaan serta dua ukuran yang benar, lalu tandai angka desimal dan satuannya. Ini revisi sesudah key terlihat, bukan attempt baru.
feedback.next_task: Listening Making Social Contact in the UK, Q11–16, sesuai alur tambahan hari ini; verifikasi paket sebelum attempt baru. Sesudah itu Reading Marie Curie; cadangan Rockets sesuai rotasi.

result.uncertainty: Jumlah putaran audio, waktu aktual, dan paparan key sebelum attempt belum dikonfirmasi; tidak dipakai untuk inferensi perkembangan kemampuan. Nomor 5 tetap ,5 sebagaimana input.
